packageRules.description: Plugin bumps are not live until each machine refreshes its marketplace clone and reinstalls, so put the commands in the PR body. The install list is maintained by hand — add a line whenever a plugin is added to marketplace.json.
prBodyNotes: Merging does not update any machine. The local marketplace clone is a cached checkout and installed plugins are pinned copies, so both steps are needed on **each machine**:
Every plugin is listed so the block can be pasted without working out which one this PR bumped — reinstalling an unchanged plugin is a no-op.
`marketplace update` refreshes the catalogue only — it does not touch anything already installed. Installs default to `--scope user`.
Verify with `claude plugin list`; the version shown should match the `ref` in this diff.
